exposure: Sophrology childbirth-Kegel-Lamaze respiratory training (SLK triple therapy)
cohort: The study included 240 single-pregnant primiparous Chinese women, divided into a control group and an SLK triple therapy group.
finding: SLK triple therapy significantly improved maternal and fetal health outcomes, including better natural delivery rates, reduced postpartum complications, improved pelvic floor function, decreased depression, and enhanced sexual function.
mod_finding: Women in the SLK triple therapy group had a significantly better natural delivery rate compared to the control group.
followup_time: N/A (observations were taken postpartum, but a specific duration is not mentioned)
birth_weight: Measured (newborn body weight was evaluated and found to be significantly higher in the SLK group, but no specific inclusion criteria based on weight were mentioned)
